criteria.statement: Authenticated clients can fetch topology assessments from /api/continuity/topology.
Authenticated clients can POST worker_pubkey to /api/continuity/simulate and receive simulated assessments.
Continuity UI renders topology survivability, recipe coverage, standby count, replication, and heartbeat signals.
Continuity UI supports failure simulation with loading, error, empty, comparison, and unsatisfied warning states using Svelte 5 event syntax.
